hook: UUIDs generate 79 times faster than ULIDs

beats.say: The author generated a million of each ID on Node.js: UUID version 4 hit about seven million a second, ULID about 89 thousand.
UUID version 4 is sixteen random bytes with dashes, while ULID packs a 48-bit timestamp first, so only ULID sorts by creation time.
CUID2 runs a hash to resist guessing, and the lesson is to pick for your database index, not by habit.
